pages.text: The reborn Core's Forge makes the last materials by hand, and after every forging it must re-seed its universe: three minutes before it compiles anything again. The $(item)Eschaton Foundry$() makes four of them in bulk - the $(item)Absolute Singularity$(), the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(), $(item)Eschaton Cells$() and the $(item)Eschaton Core$() - with a Rekindled Spark resting in it.

It costs far more than the Forge, and it only repeats: each thing it makes, its owner must have forged by hand at least once. Until then it reports $(thing)Forge it once by hand first$(). (The Pleroma Reconstitutor still makes Omnipotent Ingots, Crystals of Transcendence and Omnipotence Shards.)

Its physics is $(thing)Bekenstein's bound$(): a volume of radius R holding energy E can store at most S = 2πRE/(ħc ln 2) bits. Each forging needs a certain amount of information packed in - more energy, or more room. But the radius must stay outside the Schwarzschild radius 2GE/c⁴, or the energy is a black hole. The best forgings sit just outside that edge.
